name: aiforging
description: AI Forging — a structured AI-assisted development framework for producing robust, maintainable codebases. Test-first with one scoped test suite per feature, pattern-driven refactoring, domain-driven architecture, and two optional post-implementation verification stages (browser testing against a human QA checklist, and a review/triage/fix loop). Installed as a set of conventions, skills, and a prescriptive setup flow.
